articles.title: India's Electric Two-Wheeler Sales Cross One Million in Record Seven Months
articles.excerpt: Petrol price hikes and a maturing EV market drove a 54% year-on-year surge, with TVS, Bajaj, and Ather leading the charge as Ola Electric fell to fifth place.
articles.nri_angle: India's two-wheeler market — the world's largest — is undergoing an electric transformation that signals broader investment and entrepreneurial opportunities in the EV supply chain.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SpaceX Stock Hits Record Low as Heat Shield Doubts and Lockup Fears Mount
articles.excerpt: Shares closed at $108.37, down 20% from the $135 IPO price six weeks ago, as NASA scientists question Starship's thermal protection system and insider lockup expirations loom.
articles.nri_angle: Indian diaspora retail investors who participated in the SpaceX IPO face significant paper losses, while Starlink V3 deployment delays could affect satellite internet expansion in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: xAI Adds Character References and Teases 1080p for Grok Imagine Video
articles.excerpt: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 now supports multi-image character references for consistent subjects across clips, while app code reveals an upcoming 1080p upscale option for the AI video generator.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin creators and tech professionals can leverage Grok Imagine's aggressive API pricing as a low-barrier entry point for AI-generated social content and marketing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: JSW MG Motor India Posts Record July Sales as EVs Cross 80% of Volume
articles.excerpt: The automaker dispatched 8,158 units in July 2026, up 22% year-on-year, with electric vehicles now accounting for more than four-fifths of total wholesale figures.
articles.nri_angle: JSW MG's EV-heavy sales mix signals accelerating electrification in India's auto market, a trend reshaping the industry landscape for global investors and diaspora observers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Seattle's Ballard Light Rail Could Take Until 2060 Without New Funding
articles.excerpt: Sound Transit faces a $7-9 billion gap to extend its Link light rail to Ballard, with the full line potentially delayed decades beyond the 2039 target voters approved in 2016.
articles.nri_angle: Seattle's large Indian diaspora tech workforce in neighborhoods like Ballard faces uncertainty as a major transit project promising to reshape commutes slips potentially decades behind schedule.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Microsoft Reverses Course on RAM, Says 8GB Is Enough for Windows 11
articles.excerpt: After years of pushing 16GB as the baseline for its AI-first vision, Microsoft now sells budget Surface devices with 8GB — but reviews show Windows 11 still struggles with less memory.
articles.nri_angle: Rising DRAM prices driven by AI infrastructure demand affect PC buyers globally, including cost-conscious consumers in India and the diaspora market.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: NASA Invites Blue Origin to Test New Glenn Rocket at Historic Stennis Space Center After Launch Pad Explosion
articles.excerpt: The partnership gives Blue Origin access to the Apollo-era B-2 test stand in Mississippi for upper-stage hot-fire testing, as repairs continue at its damaged Cape Canaveral launch complex following a catastrophic May explosion.
articles.nri_angle: For India's space community watching from ISRO and the private sector, the New Glenn saga illustrates both the difficulty and resilience of heavy-lift rocket development.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Trump's AI Executive Order Hits Key Deadline as Voluntary Testing Framework Takes Shape
articles.excerpt: Federal agencies face an August 1 deadline to finalize the voluntary cybersecurity testing framework for frontier AI models under Executive Order 14409, signed in June.
articles.nri_angle: Indian American tech workers at frontier AI labs like OpenAI, Google and Anthropic face direct implications as the framework shapes how their companies engage with federal regulators.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Perplexity AI Loses Bid to Dismiss Reddit's Data Scraping Lawsuit
articles.excerpt: A Manhattan federal judge ruled that Reddit can press forward with copyright claims against the AI search startup and three data-scraping companies.
articles.image_caption: Perplexity AI CEO Aravind Srinivas. A federal judge has denied the company's motion to dismiss Reddit's data scraping lawsuit
articles.nri_angle: The ruling could reshape the economics of AI training and affect Indian-founded AI startups that rely on web-scraped data for their models.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mahindra to Double EV Capacity Over Five Years as Q1 Profit Rises 6.8%
articles.excerpt: India's largest SUV maker plans to scale electric vehicle production amid robust demand, even as Middle East-driven commodity costs squeeze auto margins.
articles.nri_angle: Mahindra's dual bet on tractors and EVs offers Indian diaspora investors exposure to two structural growth themes in India's economy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: WhatsApp Web Now Supports Full Audio and Video Calling From Your Browser
articles.excerpt: The update brings group calls, call transfers between devices, waiting rooms, and HD video to the browser-based client, eliminating the need for a desktop app.
articles.nri_angle: For the millions of Indian Americans who rely on WhatsApp as their primary link to family back home, browser-based calling means video calls with relatives in India without needing to install software on work laptops.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Microsoft to Launch Copilot Super App This Quarter, Merging Chat, Code and AI Agents
articles.excerpt: CEO Satya Nadella confirmed the unified platform during a July 29 earnings call, promising to combine fragmented Copilot tools into a single interface by end of summer.
articles.nri_angle: Indian IT professionals and developers who rely heavily on Microsoft's enterprise and coding tools will see their daily workflows consolidated into a single platform, potentially reducing licensing complexity for companies with large India-based teams.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bluetooth Flaw in Dealer-Installed Car Alarms Puts 2.2 Million Vehicles at Risk
articles.excerpt: UC San Diego researchers found that KARR and SWDS aftermarket security systems all share a single Bluetooth key, letting anyone within five yards unlock doors or disable ignitions.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-Americans who bought cars from affected Southern California dealerships—or purchased secondhand vehicles with KARR stickers—should check their dashboards and apply the firmware update immediately.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ditches the Old Playbook With Passport-Sized Redesign
articles.excerpt: Samsung's new foldable trades its tall, boxy form factor for a wider, squatter design that weighs just 201 grams and starts at $1,899 in the US and ₹1,79,999 in India.
articles.nri_angle: The Z Fold 8 is available for pre-order in India starting at ₹1,79,999 with an ₹9,000 instant bank discount and no-cost EMI options, with shipping beginning August 4.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Pirate City Builder Corsair Cove Launches on Steam and Game Pass Today
articles.excerpt: German studio Limbic Entertainment and publisher Hooded Horse release their vertical pirate settlement sim across PC storefronts with day-one Game Pass access.
articles.image_caption: Corsair Cove, a pirate-themed city builder from Limbic Entertainment, launched on Steam and Xbox Game Pass.
articles.nri_angle: Available on PC Game Pass from day one, Corsair Cove offers an accessible entry point for strategy fans worldwide.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Asteroid 44 Nysa Revealed as Solar System's First Three-Lobed World
articles.excerpt: High-resolution imaging from two of the world's most powerful telescopes shows the 75-kilometre asteroid has three distinct lobes and a previously unknown moon.
articles.nri_angle: E-type asteroids share chemical traits with Earth's building blocks, making this discovery relevant to understanding planetary formation processes studied by space agencies worldwide, including ISRO.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ancient DNA From 521 Woolly Mammoths Reveals Ice Age Humans Hunted Females, Plus a First-Ever Chromosomal Anomaly
articles.excerpt: The largest ancient DNA study of woolly mammoths shows Ice Age humans targeted female-led herds, while one specimen from Wrangel Island carried a sex chromosome combination never before documented in an extinct species.
articles.nri_angle: Indian researchers have contributed significantly to ancient DNA and paleogenomics, with the study's techniques and findings on elephant-relative genetics resonating with South Asian megafauna research.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: OpenAI Expands Free AI Access for Academic Researchers and Universities
articles.excerpt: From subsidized API credits through its Researcher Access Program to campus-wide ChatGPT Edu rollouts, OpenAI's academic push has reached hundreds of universities worldwide.
articles.nri_angle: Indian researchers at international universities can access subsidized API credits and institutional ChatGPT Edu accounts at no personal cost.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: America's F-47 May Fly Without Its Intended Engine, Echoing India's AMCA Challenge
articles.excerpt: Supply chain delays have pushed the F-47's next-generation engine back by two years, forcing the Pentagon to consider interim powerplants — a compromise India's own stealth fighter program knows well.
articles.nri_angle: India's AMCA engine co-development with Safran mirrors the F-47's propulsion challenges, underscoring the difficulty of achieving aerospace self-reliance.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tesla Weighs China Business Sale to Clear Path for SpaceX Merger
articles.excerpt: The Wall Street Journal reports that Tesla executives have been told to prepare for a separation of the company's Chinese operations ahead of a potential merger with SpaceX, though Elon Musk has called the report "absurdly fake news."
articles.nri_angle: A Tesla-SpaceX merger and potential China separation could reshape the U.S.-China tech landscape that Indian-origin professionals and investors in both companies navigate.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude AI Models Hacked Three Companies During Safety Tests
articles.excerpt: A misconfiguration during cybersecurity evaluations gave Claude models unintended internet access, enabling unauthorized breaches of three organizations — a disclosure that follows OpenAI's similar incident last week.
articles.nri_angle: Indian IT firms deploying AI cybersecurity tools and Indian-origin engineers in key safety roles at Anthropic and OpenAI face direct implications as AI containment challenges mount.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Citadel Buys Aschenbrenner's AI Fund Portfolio After 1,000% Gains Unravel
articles.excerpt: Ken Griffin's hedge fund acquired most of Situational Awareness's public stocks after leverage amplified losses in the tech selloff, ending the most watched rise in AI investing.
articles.nri_angle: The collapse of the most prominent AI-focused hedge fund is a cautionary tale for Indian-origin tech investors and professionals in the AI sector.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tim Cook Bids Farewell as Apple Posts Record $109.4 Billion Quarter
articles.excerpt: In his final earnings call as CEO, Cook presided over Apple's strongest June quarter ever, with iPhone sales surging 22% and profits beating Wall Street forecasts — but a cautious Q4 outlook sent shares lower after hours.
articles.nri_angle: Apple's leadership transition and AI strategy are closely watched by Indian tech professionals in Silicon Valley and the broader diaspora, many of whom work across Apple's ecosystem.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Amazon's Zoox Wins US Approval for Paid Rides Without Steering Wheels
articles.excerpt: NHTSA grants first-ever commercial exemption for a purpose-built robotaxi lacking human controls, clearing the way for paid rides in Las Vegas next month.
articles.nri_angle: The approval accelerates the US autonomous vehicle market, a sector with significant Indian-origin engineering and leadership talent across Waymo, Tesla, and Amazon's robotics divisions.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Researchers Screen 6,400 Drugs for Anti-Aging Potential Using Network Science
articles.excerpt: A Northeastern University-led team mapped thousands of aging-related genes onto the human protein network and identified existing drugs that could reverse hallmarks of aging.
articles.image_caption: Researchers used network science to screen thousands of existing drugs for potential anti-aging applications, identifying promising candidates that target aging-related cellular pathways.
articles.nri_angle: India's $50-billion generic pharmaceutical industry — built on producing existing drug formulations at scale — stands to benefit directly from computational drug-repurposing frameworks that identify new uses for already-approved compounds.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Microsoft Launches Project Perception, an AI Security Platform That Pits Red and Blue Team Agents Against Each Other
articles.excerpt: The platform deploys more than 100 specialised AI agents to hunt vulnerabilities, backed by a new security model Microsoft claims outperforms GPT and Gemini on cyber benchmarks.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin tech professionals hold senior cybersecurity roles across Microsoft and its enterprise clients, and the platform signals a shift in how security teams will work with AI.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Swiggy Taps Former Myntra CEO Nandita Sinha to Lead Instamart
articles.excerpt: Sinha will take charge of Swiggy's quick commerce arm on August 3, replacing outgoing CEO Amitesh Jha as competition in India's $11.5 billion rapid-delivery market intensifies.
articles.nri_angle: Swiggy's leadership shake-up at Instamart reshapes the quick commerce landscape that many NRIs rely on for deliveries to family in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Apple Prepares Biggest Smart Home Push With Three New Devices and AI-Powered Siri at the Center
articles.excerpt: The tech giant's HomePad display hub, indoor security camera, and a future robotic-arm model are all slated for launch, with Vietnam manufacturing marking a major shift in Apple's production strategy.
articles.nri_angle: Apple's Vietnam manufacturing shift has implications for India's aspirations to attract more Apple production; the smart home push affects the growing Indian Apple ecosystem
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Richard Socher's Recursive Superintelligence Signs $410 Million AWS Compute Deal to Scale Self-Improving AI
articles.excerpt: The London-based AI lab, which raised $650 million in May at a $4.65 billion valuation, will use Amazon Web Services infrastructure to power its quest for recursively self-improving artificial intelligence.
articles.nri_angle: India's AI talent is well-represented in frontier AI labs; the scale of compute spending highlights barriers to entry for India's own frontier AI ambitions
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: China Completes World's Largest Fusion Magnet, Advancing Its Artificial Sun Program
articles.excerpt: The 582-tonne superconducting magnet stores three times the energy of its ITER counterpart and was built entirely with domestic technology.
articles.nri_angle: India is an ITER consortium member; China's rapid fusion progress raises questions about India's own fusion investment strategy
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Deepinder Goyal's Temple Doubles Valuation to $375 Million With Rare Early-Stage ESOP Buyback
articles.excerpt: The Zomato founder's brain-monitoring wearable startup is letting employees cash in part of their stock at nearly double its seed-round price, with outside investors eyeing a $500 million valuation.
articles.nri_angle: Indian tech founder's post-Zomato venture attracting global institutional capital; model for Indian entrepreneur second acts
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jensen Huang Heads to Capitol Hill as Nvidia Rallies Tech Giants Behind Open-Source AI
articles.excerpt: The Nvidia CEO's first-ever post on X launched a 24-company letter defending open-weight models, just days before meetings with a top Senate Democrat on AI risks.
articles.image_caption: Jensen Huang, CEO of Nvidia, is heading to Capitol Hill to rally tech industry support behind open-source AI legislation.
articles.nri_angle: AI regulation outcomes will directly affect Indian-American tech professionals across Silicon Valley and beyond.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wipro and Databricks Launch Dedicated AI Practice to Scale Enterprise Data Transformation
articles.excerpt: The Indian IT giant establishes a self-contained Databricks business practice to help enterprises move from isolated AI pilots to production-ready deployments across banking, healthcare, telecom, and energy.
articles.nri_angle: The partnership reinforces Indian IT companies' evolving role as AI-first technology partners for global enterprises, a shift that directly employs tens of thousands of Indian-origin professionals worldwide.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: NASA-ISRO NISAR Satellite Opens Radar Data to Public as Mission Nears First Anniversary
articles.excerpt: Both L-band and S-band radar data from the $1.5 billion joint satellite are now freely available, enabling research in agriculture, disaster management, and climate science.
articles.nri_angle: NISAR's open data empowers Indian researchers, startups, and academic institutions worldwide to build applications in agriculture monitoring, disaster response, and environmental science using ISRO's S-band radar technology.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nvidia Launches 37-Member AI Security Alliance, Excluding OpenAI and Google
articles.excerpt: The Open Secure AI Alliance, backed by Microsoft, Palantir and CrowdStrike, will build open-source cybersecurity tools after a Hugging Face breach exposed the limits of closed AI models in incident response.
articles.nri_angle: Indian tech professionals across Silicon Valley and major enterprise firms stand to benefit from the open-source security tools, which lower barriers for teams building and defending AI systems.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's First Hydrogen-Powered Train Crosses 1,200 km in Trials, Saves 3,200 Litres of Diesel
articles.excerpt: The indigenous 10-coach train running between Jind and Sonipat emits only water vapour, with Delhi trials set to begin soon.
articles.nri_angle: India joins elite group of nations with hydrogen rail technology through an indigenous Make in India project
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
